pages.raw_title: About - Company Info - Our Mission, Strategic Education, Inc.
raw_blocks: Strategic Education, Inc. (NASDAQ: STRA) is dedicated to enabling economic mobility with education. Through a suite of innovative programs and services, we help our working adult students advance their careers and improve their lives.

With a focus on improving college affordability, student engagement, and workforce readiness, we are supporting the growing majority of nontraditional students and ensuring that our graduates have the skills required to succeed in today’s jobs.
For an overview of our business, see our Company Profile .

pages.raw_title: Degrees and Certificates From Strayer University and Capella University | Universities
pages.raw_meta: Give employees affordable, flexible degree and certificate programs built for working adults—find job-relevant options in healthcare, IT, business and more.
raw_blocks: Help facilitate career growth with degrees and certificates that support your employees’ needs at every stage of their careers. Our accredited universities prioritize accessibility to high-quality education for working adults, offering flexible pricing options, including tuition-covered pathways.
Level the playing field with tuition-covered degree options

Strayer University and Capella University proudly offer Tuition Assistance Aligned Pricing (TAAP), aligning the cost of select degrees to match the annual dollar amount of your education benefit, meaning no out-of-pocket tuition cost for your employees.

Strayer University also offers Degrees@Work—a fixed-fee tuition model that provides employers with a predictable, annual investment while giving employees access to fully covered courses and degree programs.
Capella University: advanced online degrees for the modern world
Empower your team with bachelor’s, master’s and doctoral programs that prioritize their time via flexible learning formats—allowing learners to earn their degrees on their terms.
Social Work & Human Services
Innovative learning formats: FlexPath, where learners proceed at their own pace, and GuidedPath, which offers more structure.
Professionally aligned degrees that can help students meet current and future challenges in their chosen field.
Programs that are competency-based and designed for working professionals to provide immediately applicable skills.
Support for every step of your learners’ academic journey, from enrollment to graduation.

Provide your workforce with the flexibility they need to pursue higher education. Capella's groundbreaking FlexPath learning format, available in select programs, allows employees to customize their learning experience and pursue their goals on their own terms.
Work and learn at the same time: Your employees can take one or two courses at a time.
Leverage knowledge: Employees can apply their current experiences to their coursework and focus on new learning skills and competencies.
Enjoy comprehensive learning support: Your employees will have the support of an academic team including a course instructor and academic coach.
Show what they know: Employees demonstrate competency in their courses and can apply those skills to their career right away.

More than 1,000 organizations – including corporations and health care organizations – invest in their employees by partnering with Capella University to offer access to tuition savings and other education benefits.
Strayer University: 130+ years of educating working adults

Empower your employees with a variety of associate, bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Strayer features a selection of online, on-campus and hybrid learning options for your employees to learn where and when they prefer.
Career-centric education that emphasizes practical skills and knowledge tailored for tomorrow’s job market.
Smart affordability that makes quality education cost-effective and manageable for your employees.
Modern flexibility that allows students to balance education with their busy lives through online and in-person options.
Complete student support that addresses academic, career and personal needs to enhance students’ overall success.
A predictable approach to tuition assistance

Strayer University’s Degrees@Work tuition model provides your employees—and, optionally, their immediate family members—with access to courses and degrees at no cost, all through a straightforward, fixed-fee structure. Designed to support talent attraction, retention and upskilling, Degrees@Work expands access helping to future-proof your workforce and strengthen your organization.
A simplified tuition model with a flat, annual investment that can help increase ROI for employers and remove financial barriers for employees.
A seamless administrative experience for employers, ensuring cost predictability and ease of implementation.
Online, career relevant degree programs in business, IT and other in-demand fields.
A trusted education partner with 20+ years of experience working with employers.
8 out of 10 Strayer alumni agree that Strayer University equipped them with skills employers' value.
The Jack Welch Management Institute
Transform your employees into leaders through Strayer’s Top 10 ranked, online MBA program

Ranked in the top MBA programs by The Princeton Review, Jack Welch Management Institute (JWMI) MBA program will give your team a firm academic grounding in leadership strategy, marketing and finance. Each is infused with Jack Welch’s winning philosophy on leadership development, people management and more.
Interactive, 100% online courses that provide maximum flexibility.
Rigorous, real-world curriculum designed to accelerate leadership skills and careers.
Full or part-time course load options that work with employees’ busy schedules.
Industry-experienced faculty with academic credentials and practical business experience from some of the world’s top companies.
92% of alumni said their confidence as a leader has increased.
"The kind of relationship we have with Capella is essential to bridging the gap between academia and practice."
Founder and Chief Business Development Officer
The Carolina Center for ABA & Autism Treatment
